papers.title: The manufacturability and compression properties of the Schwarz Diamond type Ti6Al4V cellular lattice fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.abstract: Abstract Selective laser melting technology makes it possible to produce 3D cellular lattice structures with controlled porosity. The paper reflects to machining and examination of structures with predefined distribution, shape and size of the pores. In the study, the porous structures of Ti6Al4V were investigated. The tests were carried out using structures of spatial architecture of Schwarz D TPMS geometry with a total porosity of 60% and 80% and various pore sizes. Dimensional accuracy of additively manufactured structures was measured in relation to the 3D model. Geometry of the final structure differed from the CAD model in the range ± 0.3 mm. The surface morphology and porosity of the solid struts were also checked. The mechanical properties of the structures were determined in a static compression test.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了用于生物医学的多孔钛合金支架的增材制造和压缩性能，但缺少对疲劳性能和应力遮挡的分析。
llm.why_not_core: Does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, lacks fatigue testing, and does not report osseointegration or surface roughness.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选择性激光熔化制造可控孔隙多孔结构的可行性。
summary_zh.method: 采用Schwarz D TPMS几何设计，通过SLM制造Ti6Al4V多孔支架。
summary_zh.result: 结构尺寸精度±0.3mm，压缩性能取决于孔隙率和孔径。
summary_zh.validation: 通过静态压缩试验和显微CT验证结构力学与形貌。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the manufacturability and mechanical behavior of Ti6Al4V cellular lattice structures with controlled porosity for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Schwarz Diamond TPMS lattice designs with 60% and 80% porosity were fabricated via selective laser melting, and their dimensional accuracy and surface morphology were characterized.
summary_en.result: The as-built structures deviated from CAD models by ±0.3 mm, and static compression properties were porosity-dependent.
summary_en.validation: Dimensional accuracy was measured against CAD models, and mechanical properties were validated via static compression tests.

papers.title: The Effect of Stress Relief on the Mechanical and Fatigue Properties of Additively Manufactured AlSi10Mg Parts
papers.abstract: The heating and cooling profiles experienced during laser additive manufacturing results in residual stresses build up in the component. Therefore, it is necessary to perform post build stress relieving towards the retention and improvement of the mechanical properties. However the thermal treatments for conventional manufacturing do not seem to completely accommodate these rapid heating and cooling cycles of laser processing techniques such as powder bed fusion. Characterizations such as density measurements on the samples were performed employing the Archimedes principle; hardness testing was performed on the Zwick micro/macro (Hv) hardness tester, SEM and Electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD). Fracture toughness and crack growth was conducted on a fatigue crack machine. All characterization was done after stress relieving of Selective Laser Melting (SLM) produced samples at 300 °C for 2 hrs was performed in a furnace. The mechanical properties appear to be rather compromised instead of being enhanced desirably. As-built SLM produced tensile specimens built in different directions exhibited significantly favorable mechanical properties. However, post stress relieve thermal treatment technique deteriorated the strength while increasing the ductility significantly. Nonetheless, fatigue crack growth and fracture toughness illustrated positive outcome in terms of fatigue life on SLM produced AlSi10Mg components in application.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究非生物医用材料AlSi10Mg的应力消除热处理与疲劳性能，与生物医用植入物的应力屏蔽、多孔结构及骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve biomedical materials, porous structures for stress shielding, or osseointegration evaluation; it focuses on AlSi10Mg, a non-biocompatible alloy.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究应力消除热处理对激光选区熔化AlSi10Mg合金性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 对SLM制备的AlSi10Mg样品进行300°C/2h应力消除退火，并进行硬度、拉伸、疲劳裂纹扩展等测试
summary_zh.result: 应力消除降低了强度但提高了延展性，疲劳裂纹扩展寿命得到改善
summary_zh.validation: 通过硬度、拉伸、SEM和EBSD表征验证热处理效果

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the effect of stress relief heat treatment on the mechanical and fatigue properties of AlSi10Mg parts produced by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were stress relieved at 300°C for 2 hours followed by hardness, tensile, and fatigue crack growth tests.
summary_en.result: Stress relief reduced strength but increased ductility, and improved fatigue crack growth life.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through hardness measurements, tensile testing, SEM, and EBSD characterization.

papers.title: Double-Network Hydrogels Including Enzymatically Crosslinked Poly-(2-alkyl-2-oxazoline)s for 3D Bioprinting of Cartilage-Engineering Constructs
papers.abstract: Double-network (DN) hydrogels are fabricated from poly(2-ethyl-2-oxazoline) (PEOXA)-peptide conjugates, which can be enzymatically crosslinked in the presence of Sortase A (SA), and physical networks of alginate (Alg), yielding matrices with improved mechanical properties with respect to the corresponding PEOXA and Alg single networks and excellent cell viability of encapsulated human auricular chondrocytes (hACs). The addition of a low content of cellulose nanofibrils (CNFs) within DN hydrogel formulations provides the rheological properties needed for extrusion-based three-dimensional (3D) printing, generating constructs with a good shape fidelity. In the presence of hACs, PEOXA-Alg-CNF prehydrogel mixtures can be bioprinted, finally generating 3D-structured DN hydrogel supports showing a cell viability of more than 90%. Expanding the application of poly(2-alkyl-2-oxazoline)-based formulations in the design of tissue-engineering constructs, this study further demonstrates how SA-mediated enzymatic crosslinking represents a suitable and fully orthogonal method to generate biocompatible hydrogels with fast kinetics.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究水凝胶材料，未涉及任何AI方法，与AI生物打印方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No AI/ML method applied; purely material formulation and bioprinting without computational intelligence.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发适合软骨组织工程的可打印双网络水凝胶。
summary_zh.method: 用酶交联聚噁唑啉和海藻酸钠制备双网络水凝胶，添加纤维素纳米纤维改善打印性。
summary_zh.result: 水凝胶具有良好力学性能，3D打印后细胞活力超过90%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过包埋人软骨细胞的体外实验验证细胞相容性。

summary_en.motivation: To develop printable double-network hydrogels with improved mechanical properties for cartilage tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: Double-network hydrogels were fabricated using enzymatically crosslinked poly(2-ethyl-2-oxazoline)-peptide conjugates and alginate, with cellulose nanofibrils added to enhance printability.
summary_en.result: The hydrogels exhibited high cell viability (>90%) after bioprinting with encapsulated human auricular chondrocytes.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell encapsulation and bioprinting experiments demonstrated biocompatibility and shape fidelity.
